method.runner: kubectl exec deploy/woo-mcp in each store namespace, using apps.woocommerce_mcp.app.client.WooClient with the pod's own credentials
method.guard: GET /orders first; abort if any order exists. No retry on error.
method.why_not_create_order_tool: Both stores had 0 products. The MCP create_order tool requires a published simple product, and WooCommerce REST rejects a line item without a product ID or SKU.
method.date: date_created is read-only in the WooCommerce 9.4.3 REST schema. The order takes the server creation time. Store timezone is UTC (gmt_offset 0, empty timezone_string), so today is 2026-10-25.
